name: Sesangeseo Gajang Wanbyeokan Boksu
source:
Filled with vengeful thoughts, I couldn't resist the devil's sweet temptation and ended up making a request I should never have made.

[b]'Please, make Jia suffer for what she did...'[/b]

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3202710]Steam[/url]]
translation:
满怀复仇的念头，我无法抗拒魔鬼甜蜜的诱惑，最终提出了一个不该提出的要求。

[b]“请让贾为她的所作所为受苦……”[/b]

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3202710]Steam[/url]]
